verdicts.reason: A breaks the quote: the reading order is scrambled (Albert Einstein sits above RELIGION, and the two subtitle lines are swapped and paired with the wrong words), RELIGION is shrunk to subtitle size, a random dark box floats on the left, and the small text sits straight on a busy, bright image. B keeps the original order and hierarchy inside a central dark panel, so it is readable and on brand. Its flaws: the panel cuts the figure in half and looks pasted on, the image is a zoomed crop with the head lost, the subtitles are small, and the attribution is left-aligned while the rest of the text is centred.
